rationale: User approved (11-19) DFT verification of LiBeSb: F-43m is the MLIP/MP-PBE ground state (wz +18 meV/atom) but experiment reports wurtzite; harmonic phonons of both give dynamical stability and F_vib(T), the term that can reverse an 18 meV/atom PBE ordering. Static energies come from the same flow.
